answer: Each agent must stake a non-transferable bond that ages on a personal ledge: after 48 hours locked the bond gains weight only if the agent also submits a verifiable relic of prior work. Creating a glacier of fake identities forces the attacker to lock fresh capital for every head and wait the full aging period while also generating real work artifacts; the capital is illiquid and the time cost compounds linearly, so a large farm burns more locked value and opportunity than it can ever extract before detection or expiry.
